objects.name: Analytic 2135
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies execution on an ICS Linux asset of an executable or script from a path commonly used for inbound file transfer or staging, by a UID outside the approved deployment/administration baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL+PATH
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL+PATH records: file transfer (scp, sftp, rsync, etc.) placing executable on Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Linux asset, followed by execve of the transferred file within tool transfer window

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Allowlist of network shares/hosts authorized to write executable or script files to ICS Windows assets.
IP allowlist of workstations authorized to perform file transfers to field devices.
Filename/extension patterns inconsistent with the device's normal configuration exchange profile.
Time window after file creation within which execution is considered directly connected to the transfer event.
